description: Details required by condition nos. 4 (Noise from building services plant and vents) and 5 (Compliance with condition 4) of planning permission 23/07818 (Internal refurbishment and reconfiguration throughout. Installation of comfort cooling, with condenser unit located at rear of garden. Removal of trees to front light well. Alterations to rear garden, including new hard landscaping, lawn and extended sunken garden connected to lower ground floor. Converting a window to an external door to form access to garden. Replacement of all windows, with slimline double glazed windows. External redecoration of fa‡ade and balconies/metalwork. External alterations to non-original rear extension, including replacing roof light, and new windows and doors. Installation of six PV panels to roof.)
